segments.t: Chef Viktor Barinov storms into the rival restaurant Arcobaleno to confront chef Elena Pavlovna. Furious that one of his Claude Monet cooks applied for a job there, he demands to know the applicant's identity. Elena playfully refuses to give up the cook's name and politely shows Barinov the door. Let's listen to their fiery confrontation in Russian.
У меня к вам совсем простой вопрос.
Как у шеф-повара к шеф-повару?
Кто из моих поваров приходил к вам?
Я не сдаю своих людей, Виктор.
Это мой повар, а не ваш!
Он хочет работать на хорошей кухне.
У меня лучшая кухня в этом городе!
Тогда почему ваши люди ищут работу?
Я обязательно узнаю его имя сам!
Мне уже пора идти на кухню.
Вы сами выход отсюда найдёте?
Найду, дорогу я отлично помню.
Вот и отлично, всего вам доброго!
Let's analyze this dramatic rivalry line by line. Observe the proud tone and formal professional banter between competing culinary masters.

'I have a very simple question for you.' Barinov states he has a very simple question.
Как у шеф-повара к шеф-повару?
'From one head chef to another?' Elena asks if it is from one head chef to another.
Кто из моих поваров приходил к вам?
'Which of my cooks came to see you?' Barinov demands to know which of his cooks visited her.
Я не сдаю своих людей, Виктор.
'I do not rat out my people, Viktor.' Elena refuses to betray her people.
Это мой повар, а не ваш!
'He is my cook, not yours!' Barinov insists the cook belongs to him.
Он хочет работать на хорошей кухне.
'He wants to work in a good kitchen.' Elena explains the cook just wants to work in a good kitchen.
У меня лучшая кухня в этом городе!
'I have the best kitchen in this city!' Barinov proudly claims his kitchen is the best in the city.
Тогда почему ваши люди ищут работу?
'Then why are your people looking for work?' Elena questions why his staff would look for work elsewhere then.
Я обязательно узнаю его имя сам!
'I will definitely find out his name myself!' Barinov vows to discover the name himself.
Мне уже пора идти на кухню.
'It is time for me to go to the kitchen.' Elena notes it is time for her to return to work.
Вы сами выход отсюда найдёте?
'Will you find the way out yourself?' Elena asks if he can find his own way out.
Найду, дорогу я отлично помню.
'I will, I remember the way very well.' Barinov confirms he remembers the route perfectly.
Вот и отлично, всего вам доброго!
'Wonderful then, all the best to you!' Elena bids him a cheerful goodbye. Now let's listen to the whole conversation again from start to finish.

Barinov leaves empty-handed, but determined to uncover the traitor in his own kitchen. Great job following this intense culinary confrontation! Next time you watch the episode, listen for the Russian expressions for 'question' and 'exit' — you will catch every word right away. See you next time!
